blind_card.visible_setting: A pristine dry apartment corridor seen entirely from outside a fully closed warm-brown wooden apartment door. The door dominates the lower frame from center-left to frame right. Its single exterior lever is on the right edge beside the man. A small, partly cropped elevator sits only in the far-left background with its doors 80 percent closed, leaving one narrow dark seam and no visible cabin. There is no elevator control, wall switch, intercom, or metal wall plate.
blind_card.observable_action: The man remains square to the apartment door on frame right and visibly wraps his right hand around its exterior lever, depressing it under testing tension. The woman is the only person reversing from the far-left elevator: her left foot still points toward it, her lifted right heel steps toward the apartment door, and three faint graphite ticks trace that return. She now stands directly before the apartment door's wooden center-left panel. Her locked right arm drives her open palm at least one handspan inside the wooden door outline, with uninterrupted brown grain around all five fingers and two short compression strokes drawn directly on the wood.
blind_card.hands_and_contact: Only two focal hands are visible. The man's right hand owns the apartment-door lever; his left hand stays behind his back. The woman's right hand owns a separate forceful push on the apartment door's wooden center-left panel; her left hand stays hidden by the tote and rolled umbrella. Her palm does not contact a wall, wall fixture, lift control, switch, plate, intercom, or doorframe. No hand or body touches the other person.
blind_card.gaze: The man looks at his handle grip and the woman looks at her palm-to-wood contact. Neither looks at the other or viewer.
blind_card.body_blocking: Both people stand on one depth plane, the man slightly taller and broader. Clear empty air separates their torsos. They do not touch, lean on each other, overlap, or merge.
blind_card.object_state: The apartment door is fully closed and visibly continuous behind both contacts. The right-edge exterior lever is depressed by the man while the woman's palm pushes the separate wooden center-left panel. The small far-left elevator is nearly shut and has no visible control panel. Her tote and tightly rolled unused umbrella remain dry. No key or fob is visible.
blind_card.camera_view: A medium-wide, straight-on full-body view makes the dominant closed brown apartment door, both separate contacts on its surface, empty torso gap, tiny far-left nearly shut elevator, and the woman's return heel readable at once.
blind_card.visible_continuity: The nearly shut far-left elevator, the woman's outward-pointing foot and reversing heel, pristine date-night clothes, tote, rolled dry umbrella, dry floor, and fully closed apartment door support a before-departure callback. There is no apartment interior, elevator cabin, elevator control, wall plate, rain exposure, food trace, visible key, arrow, ghost body, extra person, scooter, motorbike, or helmet.
